conclusions: 优先观察 0x7c85...2587：同一创建者对应 MJ、UU；GMGN 汇总 2363 内盘/36 已开盘，约1.5%为平台开盘比例，不是热币命中率、跟随胜率或盈利概率。
次级观察 0x2956...4940：同一创建者对应 DEGENIUS、屌丝；679 内盘/19 已开盘，约2.7%平台开盘比例。多数近期创建并无同等行情，不能整钱包无差别跟买。
0xec6f...2458 有 PIZZA、Four、CRAZYCOIN 等历史冲高，但 4650 内盘/81 已开盘；样本 UMA 的创建到首卖仅14秒，单靠发过热门币不足以授予开盘狙击许可。
20条活动页未覆盖完整库存和生命周期，未计算跟随盈亏；缺成本/转账/后页不视作零。
两个当前热币创建者仅经过 GMGN CA→creator 与 creator history→CA 双向身份核对，尚未独立验交易收据。未称为已确认操盘者、合格教师或稳盈 Dev。

steps: 针对优先候选按未来新CA记录创建、首次发现、首次可成交报价和Dev首次卖出的时间，不能用事后ATH挑赢家。
独立核验launch receipt，并纳入未开盘、亏损和短窗口样本；按链+CA区分同名币。
用真实收到信号后的报价加费用/滑点/Gas模型做独立模拟评估，再决定是否增加Dev路线。

changes: Four/Flap same-block metadata and quote calls use bounded <=8-item batches, through unchanged shared background coordinator; no concurrency increase.
Four 11→7, Flap native 12→8, Flap converted quote asset 15→8 HTTP requests in fixture tests; semantic RPC item counts and bidirectional/raw-proof checks unchanged.
Round deadline checked before and after RPC, after coordinator lease release and before final proof output; failure does not grant a proof.
Queue capacity contention is not treated as an upstream failure. Real network errors cool down; HTTP/JSON-RPC rate limits share cooldown.
getNetwork and callBatch aliases map to eth_chainId/eth_call cooldowns; numeric and HTTP-date Retry-After are not cut short at five minutes.
Four target seats rotate fairly after 240s only when replacements wait; held priority, 90s continuous evidence and RPC budgets remain. Evicted evidence is removed rather than spliced into re-entry.

remaining: Post-deployment public RPC_TIMEOUT and RPC_COORDINATOR_UNAVAILABLE were observed. Some chain reads succeeded, but 90-second continuous coverage was not yet achieved at the recorded check.
Depth transport version is loaded; no production depth probe was triggered in the verification window, so fixture request reduction is not a measured production latency claim.
10-second polling, confirmation depth 8 and burst 90-second evidence are not a one-second Dev sniper. No safety thresholds removed.

Next infrastructure choice: provision/authorize a dedicated BSC HTTP/WSS endpoint, isolate realtime Dev launch observation from bulk scanning, and measure detection→quote→paper fill latency and failure coverage before enabling such a route. No endpoint subscription purchased or secret inspected.
